After breakfast, visit a chocolate farm.

The tour covers the origins and history of cacao and chocolate, along with traditional production methods.

Follow the whole process, from harvesting the pods to drying and grinding the beans.

The tour includes making a traditional drink and tasting organic chocolate.

In the afternoon, visit Baldi Hot Springs.

Baldi is one of the largest hot springs complexes in the Arenal Volcano area.

Paths connect hot and cold pools of different sizes.

The pools vary in temperature, so you can alternate between warm and cool water.

After a long soak in hot water, we recommend moving to a cooler pool.

Dinner is served at Baldi in the evening.

Breakfast and dinner are included.
Visitors on a suspension bridge in the rainforest near La Fortuna, Costa Rica
La Fortuna, Costa Rica: a walk across a suspension bridge in the lush forest
Arenal to Monteverde and El Trapiche Farm

After breakfast, transfer to Monteverde.

Monteverde is known for its cloud forests and rural character. Santa Elena is the area’s main visitor hub.

After arrival, visit the family-run El Trapiche Farm.

The farm grows coffee and sugar cane.

On the tour, see how sugar cane juice is traditionally extracted and how sobado, a local speciality, is made.

You’ll also learn about the stages of coffee processing.

During the hands-on part of the tour, you can make your own sugar cane syrup and sample products from the farm.

Breakfast is included.
